info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Location Operations Status API
info.description: The Branch Location Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of branch locations within the banking system. It enables users to monitor the availability and performance of various branch-specific services and operations. This API is particularly useful for business analysts and operational managers who need to ensure seamless service delivery to customers. By leveraging this API, organizations can proactively address issues, optimize resource allocation, and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of branch location operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of operations related to branch locations within a specific channel. It provides insights into various operational states and can be useful for monitoring and optimizing branch performance.

requestBody.description: Requires status information related to the branch location operations. This request body should follow the schema defined for retrieving the operation status.

200.description: Success: The request has been processed and returns the current status.

GetBranchLocationOperationsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of operations for a specific branch location in the context of a channel.

GetBranchLocationOperationsStatusRespons.title: Branch Location Operations Status Response

regionCode.description: Code representing the region the branch is located in.

serviceWindow.description: The service hours of the branch.

dailyCapacity.description: Total number of services the branch can handle in a day.

branchType.description: Type of the branch (e.g., retail, online, etc.).

timeZone.description: Time zone in which the branch operates.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the branch record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the branch details.

GetBranchLocationOperationsStatusRespons.description: Response schema for the operations status of a specific branch location.

ServiceWindow.title: Service Window

opensAt.description: Opening time of the service window in HH:mm format.

closesAt.description: Closing time of the service window in HH:mm format.

ServiceWindow.description: Defines the operating hours for a service.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to trace the request through various systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication scheme. Clients can authenticate by including a Bearer token in the Authorization header. The token should be in JWT (JSON Web Token) format.
